hints.title: Consecutive Character Run Counting
hints.text: Traverse the string while keeping track of current run lengths for both characters.

hints.title: Maximum Run Updates
hints.text: Update the maximum consecutive 1s when seeing 1 and the maximum consecutive 0s when seeing 0.

hints.title: Strict Inequality Comparison
hints.text: Compare the two maximum run lengths and return whether max 1s is strictly greater than max 0s.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning substring ranges independently takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan tracking running streak counters runs in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tracks both character runs simultaneously in a single pass.
